blocks.text: October 16 to 18, 2026 event offers up to 70% off, bundle deals, and exclusive rewards to help shoppers save on everyday needs. More than a celebration of another year, the three-day sale is Metro’s way of helping consumers cope with the rising cost of living by offering bigger discounts, bundle deals, and special promotions on products they need for their homes and families. With the prices of everyday goods continuing to put pressure on household budgets, homemakers and families are becoming more mindful of where and how they spend their money.
